from common import *

import numpy as np
from typing import *

# concepts:
# color_selection, object_detection

# description:
# Identify and select all connected components of a fixed color from the input grid.
# Each component is defined by 4-connectivity and must match the specified color exactly.
# The output grid contains only the selected components, with all other cells set to color 0.

def main(input_grid: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    # The specified color to be selected
    specified_color = Color.GREEN  # This can be changed or made dynamic based on puzzle needs

    # Prepare output grid with the same shape as input, initialized to black
    output_grid = np.zeros_like(input_grid)
    
    # Find all connected components of the specified color
    visited = np.zeros_like(input_grid, dtype=bool)
    n, m = input_grid.shape
    
    def dfs(x, y):
        # If out of bounds or already visited or not the specified color, return
        if x < 0 or x >= n or y < 0 or y >= m or visited[x, y] or input_grid[x, y] != specified_color:
            return
        # Mark as visited and set the output grid to the specified color
        visited[x, y] = True
        output_grid[x, y] = specified_color
        
        # Visit all 4-connected neighbors
        dfs(x + 1, y)
        dfs(x - 1, y)
        dfs(x, y + 1)
        dfs(x, y - 1)

    # Perform DFS on each unvisited cell of the specified color
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if input_grid[i, j] == specified_color and not visited[i, j]:
                dfs(i, j)

    return output_grid

def generate_input() -> np.ndarray:
    # Generate a grid with random size from 10x10 to 20x20
    n, m = random.randint(10, 20), random.randint(10, 20)
    grid = np.zeros((n, m), dtype=int)

    # Scatter random colors over the grid
    randomly_scatter_points(grid, color=random.choice(Color.NOT_BLACK), density=0.3)

    # Add random connected components of the specified color
    specified_color = Color.GREEN  # This can be changed or made dynamic based on puzzle needs
    for _ in range(random.randint(1, 5)):  # Add 1 to 5 components
        sprite = random_sprite(random.randint(2, 5), random.randint(2, 5), color_palette=[specified_color], connectivity=4)
        x, y = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, sprite)
        blit_sprite(grid, sprite, x, y)

    return grid

Description: 
Given a grid with various colored objects, draw a line from a specified start
point to an end point. The line must navigate around obstacles, which are defined as
objects that block the path. The line should follow the shortest path possible using
4-connectivity, avoiding any grid cells occupied by obstacles.
